text.content:
A rock star who made it.

Role: Rockerboy
Where to find them: An estate in North Oak
Known for: A regular at the Time Machine in the Glen

One of Night City's famous musicians, with an estate in North Oak patrolled by security bots. He shops for old guitars at the Time Machine, the Glen's antiques and vintage tech store.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.23; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.09, 10
